name: Exp_TriXCandle
summary: This EA trades based on the TriXCandle custom indicator, which is a TRIX-based momentum oscillator rendered as candlesticks. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward momentum shift and sell positions on a downward shift, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于TriXCandle自定义指标进行交易，该指标是基于TRIX的动量振荡器并以K线形式呈现。当指标发出向上动量转变信号时开多仓，向下动量转变时开空仓，具有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用TriXCandle指标作为核心策略信号源，TriXCandle是基于TRIX动量振荡器的自定义指标，以K线形态显示趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的值为2且前一值小于2时，产生买入开仓信号；当值为0且前一值大于0时，产生卖出开仓信号。出场条件包括：买入信号出现时同时平掉卖出仓位，卖出信号出现时平掉买入仓位，以及固定的止损和止盈水平。仓位管理采用5种模式（FREEMARGIN、BALANCE、LOSSFREEMARGIN、LOSSBALANCE、LOT），默认使用固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。EA还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，并通过Recount标志处理指标数据未就绪的情况。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the TriXCandle indicator as its core signal source, which is a custom indicator based on the TRIX momentum oscillator displayed in candlestick form to show trend direction. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 4 value equals 2 and the previous value is less than 2, a buy open signal is generated; when the value equals 0 and the previous value is greater than 0, a sell open signal is generated. Exit conditions include: closing sell positions when a buy signal appears, closing buy positions when a sell signal appears, and fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing supports 5 modes (FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, LOT), defaulting to fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The EA also uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and employs a Recount flag to handle cases where indicator data is not yet ready.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, controls lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：可用保证金/余额/亏损保证金/亏损余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode: Free margin/Balance/Loss margin/Loss balance/Fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（多仓止盈止损外平仓）
parameters.description_en: Allow buy to close (close long beyond SL/TP)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（空仓止盈止损外平仓）
parameters.description_en: Allow sell to close (close short beyond SL/TP)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

pros: 使用IsNewBar机制防止同一K线重复开仓，有效控制交易频率
提供5种仓位管理模式，灵活性较高，适应不同风险偏好
止损和止盈参数可配置，默认止盈是止损的2倍，具有正期望的风险回报比
买卖开仓和平仓可独立开关控制，策略配置灵活
使用Recount标志处理指标数据未就绪的情况，具备基本容错能力
pros_en: Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate entries on the same bar, effectively controlling trade frequency
Provides 5 position sizing modes with good flexibility for different risk preferences
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit with default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, offering positive expectancy
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled, providing flexible strategy configuration
Uses Recount flag to handle indicator data not-ready scenarios, providing basic fault tolerance
cons: 完全依赖单一自定义指标TriXCandle，无内置指标交叉验证，信号可靠性存疑
默认止损1000点和止盈2000点过大，对大多数货币对而言不够精细
缺乏点差过滤机制，在点差较大时可能不当开仓
没有持仓数量限制，可能在极端行情中积累过多仓位
指标缓冲区4的魔数含义（0/2）不透明，代码可读性和可维护性差
cons_en: Relies entirely on a single custom indicator TriXCandle without cross-validation from built-in indicators, signal reliability is questionable
Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large for most currency pairs
Lacks spread filtering mechanism, may open positions inappropriately during high-spread conditions
No position count limit, could accumulate excessive positions during extreme market conditions
Indicator buffer 4 magic values (0/2) are opaque, resulting in poor code readability and maintainability
improvements: 增加多指标交叉确认机制，如加入MACD或均线过滤，提高信号可靠性
添加点差过滤和波动率适应性止损止盈，使风险管理更精细
增加最大持仓数量限制和资金回撤保护，防止极端行情下过度风险暴露
improvements_en: Add multi-indicator cross-confirmation such as MACD or moving average filtering to improve signal reliability
Add spread filtering and volatility-adaptive stop-loss/take-profit for more refined risk management
Add maximum position count limits and drawdown protection to prevent excessive risk exposure in extreme markets

risk_points: 缺乏点差过滤，高点差环境下可能不利成交
默认止损止盈点数过大（1000/2000），单笔风险较高
依赖外部自定义指标TriXCandle，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行
risk_points_en: No spread filtering, unfavorable fills possible in high-spread environments
Default stop-loss/take-profit points are very large (1000/2000), high per-trade risk
Depends on external custom indicator TriXCandle, EA fails if indicator file is missing
